title: Landing page blocks with arcing hero letters
summary: A rebuilt landing page fades up on a pale backdrop; the headline rises out of line masks, block copy and avatars cascade in, and one word's letters swing along an arc into a vertical stack beside the hero photo. Holds, then fades out.
use_when: Showing a website or landing page design as a short silent loop
A studio or agency portfolio post where one page layout is the subject
Opening a site launch film on the hero section before a scroll tour
Social cutdowns that need one calm 5 s product moment

look.type_style: heavy geometric grotesk headline, sentence case, tight leading, 3 lines at ~8 % H; arc word in a wide monospace lowercase ~7 % H; small regular sans body ~2.5 % H

sfx.event: headline lines rise out of their masks

structure.shot: empty pale backdrop, then the page card with nav bar, hero panel with cutout portrait and three empty lower blocks fades up
structure.camera: locked; page card rises ~1 % H while fading in
structure.motion: f0 empty; page opacity 0 to 1 and rise ~1 % H f1 to f6, easings.outExpo 6 fr; blocks and portrait arrive with the page, not staggered

structure.shot: hero headline, 3 short lines, rises in; pill button, quote block copy and mission copy fade in; arc letters start entering top right
structure.motion: headline lines mask-rise from f8, line stagger ~2 fr, springs.maskRise ~10 fr (overshoot not measurable); target icon fades f12; pill fades f14 to f18; left block copy f13 to f22, middle block copy f16 to f24, easings.outQuint; avatars pop f22, f25, f28, springs.pop (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: letters of one 6-letter word swing along an arc around the portrait and settle as a vertical stack; two small glyph icons appear beside them
structure.motion: letters travel a clockwise arc from the top-right corner, each rotating to its final angle, start f12, settle ~f57, easings.outQuint ~45 fr, letter stagger ~3 fr (±0.25 s); asterisk glyph fades f35, half-disc glyph f48

structure.shot: finished landing page holds: headline, button, three blocks, arc word, gradient orb block
structure.motion: no element moves; gradient orb in the right block shifts hue slowly (blue toward mint), easings.linear across the hold

structure.shot: the whole page fades into the pale backdrop and shrinks slightly; last cells show the empty backdrop, matching frame 0
structure.motion: page opacity 1 to 0 and scale 1.00 to 0.97 f132 to f143, easings.inOutSine 11 fr; empty backdrop f143 to f150

params.brand: any brand.json: display font for the headline, mono for the arc word, bg for the backdrop, accent for the pill button gradient
params.content.wordmark: site wordmark in the nav, top left
params.content.nav: 3 nav labels plus one dark pill button label
params.content.headline: hero statement, 3 short lines, 1 to 2 words each
params.content.arcWord: one word of 4 to 7 letters that swings along the arc
params.content.blocks: two lower blocks: a short quote paragraph (4 lines) and a mission line (3 lines) with a team label
params.content.portrait: cutout portrait or product image for the hero panel (transparent PNG)
params.timing.hold: frames the finished page holds before the exit (default 72)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; blocks restack below the hero for tall aspects
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips at t = 0, 1, 4 s (480 px wide): page fade-up 6 fr, headline from f8, arc letters f12 to ~f57, exit f132 to f143. No camera move: motion.json reports zoom of -1 to -3.5 %/s but frame diff is ~0 from 2 to 4 s, so it is noise. Loops cleanly because frame 0 and the last frames are both the empty backdrop. Proposed term arc-letters (letters travel along a curved path and rotate into a vertical word) is not in the vocabulary and is not used in techniques. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured; the reference is silent.
